data.description: Implements the three highest-leverage recommendations from the 2026-06-08 FP-analysis of ~48 fp-recovery override PRs (~175 findings). Root cause: T5+T6 test-review misjudgment ~44% of FPs; non-convergent FP-amplification (bug 2195); no structured FP audit trail.
data.title: Reduce + audit LLM-review false positives (FP-analysis follow-up)
